reason: The only cited evidence (E1) demonstrates acoustic mixing of Y2O3 into a different alloy (NiCoCr) and subsequent PBF processing, but provides no data on residual stress, grain refinement, mechanical property improvement, or any results for the AlCrFeNiSi system. The key premises about stress reduction, property enhancement, and applicability to AlCrFeNiSi are entirely unsupported by the cited passage.
